body.description: top-down view of the left half of a Roman colosseum arena, seen from above: a wide floor of packed ochre sand with a few small pebbles, enclosed by a thick sandstone wall of large cut blocks along the whole top edge, a thinner sandstone wall along the left edge and along the bottom edge, the sand floor continuing out past the right edge; no people, no lettering; pixel art with a dark warm-brown outline instead of black, gentle shading, light from the top left
